preamble.title: stellaris/tessera
preamble.description: Tessera (TSRA) reserve-backed stablecoin, sTessera yield vault and redemption queue for Cardano (Preprod)

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

reserve/ReserveRedeemer.title: ReserveRedeemer
reserve/ReserveRedeemer.description:
`holder` on Mint / Burn is the party whose eligibility is checked when the
 matching KYC switch is on; it is ignored while the switch is off.

anyOf.title: StakeShort
anyOf.description: Stake `amount` TSRA into the short tier for sTSRA.

anyOf.title: StakeLong
anyOf.description: Stake `amount` TSRA into a long-tier Position payable to `owner`.

anyOf.title: RequestUnstake
anyOf.description: Burn `shares` sTSRA into a cooldown Ticket payable to `owner`.

anyOf.title: Claim
anyOf.description: Claim a Ticket after its cooldown (spends the Ticket only).

anyOf.title: UnlockLong
anyOf.description: Pay out a long-tier Position after `unlock_at` (State + Position).

anyOf.title: ReportYield
anyOf.description: Committee: credit `gross` TSRA of delivered yield.

anyOf.title: SetBounds
anyOf.description: Committee: change the bounds within their hard limits.

tessera/reserve_state/ReserveState.title: ReserveState
tessera/reserve_state/ReserveState.description:
PROVISIONAL until counsel answers (SPEC.md §1): the committee model, the
 attestation format, any on-chain reserve asset and the KYC switches may
 still change.

fields.title: minted_supply
fields.description: TSRA currently in existence (1e-6 TSRA units).

fields.title: attested_reserve
fields.description: Reserve the committee last attested to, in the same units.

fields.title: attestation_epoch
fields.description: Number of attestations recorded so far (0 at genesis).

fields.title: attested_at
fields.description: POSIX ms of the last attestation (genesis: the bootstrap tx's lower bound).

fields.title: epoch
fields.description: Monotonic replay counter: exactly one State transition per tx.

fields.title: kyc_mint
fields.description:
Per-action eligibility switches (Phase 2.3). When on, the action calls
 `tessera/eligibility.eligible`. All off on Preprod.

fields.title: kyc_stake
fields.description:
Read by the sTessera vault (not written yet); stored here so one
 committee transaction controls every switch.

fields.title: eligibility_policy
fields.description:
Policy of the eligibility tokens (`validators/eligibility.ak` at launch).
 Set at genesis; `SetKyc` (committee) may repoint it, e.g. to a
 Midnight-issued credential policy, without a new reserve script.

tessera/vault_state/Position.title: Position
tessera/vault_state/Position.description: A long-tier lock: `shares` of class L, payable to `owner` from `unlock_at`.

tessera/vault_state/Ticket.title: Ticket
tessera/vault_state/Ticket.description:
A short-tier cooldown claim: `value` TSRA escrowed at request time,
 payable to `owner` from `claim_after`, scaled by the loss index.

tessera/vault_state/VaultDatum.title: VaultDatum
tessera/vault_state/VaultDatum.description:
Every UTxO at the vault address carries one of these (distinct
 constructors, so a Position can never be read as a State, etc.).

tessera/vault_state/VaultState.title: VaultState
tessera/vault_state/VaultState.description: The vault's single State: both share classes' books and the bounds.

fields.title: short_shares
fields.description: Total sTSRA in existence (class S shares).

fields.title: long_shares
fields.description: Sum of `shares` over live long-tier Positions (class L).

fields.title: protocol_bps
fields.description: Protocol share of gross yield, at most `exchange.max_yield_fee_bps`.

fields.title: first_loss_addr
fields.description: Receives half the protocol cut (bootstrap parameter until 2.5).
